prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading and elevated caloric intake for high-endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/post-training nutrition timing
Total daily calories and carbohydrate intake support marathon training needs (approximately 3000+ calories, 60%+ carbs)
All meals comply with vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
Meals are practical and concise (no excessive detail)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated caloric intake and carbohydrate loading with specific timing around training

prompt_inputs.goal: muscle recovery and strength building with optimized pre/post-workout nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers 1 full day with 4-5 meals distributed around training
Protein intake distributed across meals (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight)
Includes specific pre-workout and post-workout nutrition timing and composition
Compact format with meal names, times, and key macronutrient info
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein distribution and pre/post-workout nutrition strategy for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain current weight while cutting 2kg for weigh-in in 3 days, then refuel for performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact (1 day only) with 4-5 meals listed
Total daily calories support gradual weight loss (~500-700 calorie deficit) without compromising performance
All meals are vegetarian and whole-food based with no processed ingredients
Meals prioritize nutrient density with adequate protein (1.6-1.8g per kg), carbs for training, and micronutrients for recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a weight-class constrained athlete (boxer or wrestler) requiring calorie control and nutrient density while maintaining performance and making weight
